put.description: Authorized raw document upload after claim_document_upload. Bounded to 2097152 bytes, text/plain, text/markdown, text/html, a 10000 ms deadline, and a 20s lease. Available on REST and web only. CLI and MCP send start_document_capture.text_content up to 32768 characters and do not upload raw files.
